title: Token SLI differential prober and failover scenario recorder
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a differential token-level SLI prober and an attached failover scenario recorder to improve root-cause diagnosis for multi-region latency regressions. The prober will run synthetic, controlled decodes across regions and model variants, capture per-token latency histograms and KV cache hit/miss traces, and compute a delta signal (region A vs region B, or model vX vs vY). The recorder will persist deterministic request contexts and admission/fallback decisions so failures in production failover can be replayed in a local chaos environment. This ticket focuses on instrumentation, data model, dashboard panels, and automated nightly comparisons; traffic shaping or rollouts are out of scope and will be separate tickets.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible prober job runs in staging and produces per-token latency histograms with labels: region, model_variant, route, sequence_length, prefix_hash
Delta reports generated nightly showing p50/p90/p99 token-latency differences between two regions and flagging >20% delta at p99
Failover recorder stores: request id, admission score, selected shard, fallback reason, token-by-token timings, and KV cache events in the trace store for at least 7 days
Grafana dashboard with panels: token-latency waterfall, delta heatmap, KV hit waterfall, region-failover timeline, and a replay queue visualizer
Integration tests that validate prober's determinism for fixed seeds and deterministic model variants (CI job passes)
implementation_notes: Sampling: prober will default to deterministic seeds and run at 0.5% of synthetic capacity in staging; production sampling via adaptive sampler (follow-up)
Metrics: emit token_latency_ms histogram (buckets: 0-1,1-3,3-6,6-12,12-25,25-50,50-100,100-250,250+) with label set (region, model, route, cohort)
Aggregation: compute per-request token percentiles then aggregate per-minute across requests using t-digest to approximate p50/p90/p99
Delta calculation: compute (regionB_p99 - regionA_p99)/regionA_p99 and flag if >0.2 for >5 consecutive minutes
Recorder: store small binary blobs (gzipped JSON) in trace-bucket with consistent key pattern: recorder/{date}/{region}/{request_id}. Use TTL 7d then cold archive
Privacy: no customer PII; if sticky customer-sourced traffic is used later, mask prompt content and record only prefix hashes
Performance: lightweight instrumentation path (non-blocking) using eBPF-based timing hook for decode step where possible; fall back to in-process timers
Dashboards: provide JSON model for panels so dashboards can be provisioned via infra-as-code (Grafonnet or Grafana provisioning)
